_comment: Illegal corpus, STRUCTURE / FORMAT half. Every variant is a copy of a legal
baseline (see legal.json, key = base) with ONE minimal tampering.
expect.validate / expect.validateWarnings are substrings of the messages the
format gate prints (it has no codes — docs/checks.md); expect.erc / expect.lint /
expect.drc are real finding ids. All values come from `node test/corpus.js --probe`.
expect.leak = true records a KNOWN BLIND SPOT: the tampering is asserted to slip
through; suggest documents the code a future checker should use.

illegal.name: index-profile-pcbs-missing
illegal.title: index.profile.pcbs deleted — the folder no longer declares its PCB
illegal.mutate: json_delete profile.pcbs from <name>.eprj3

illegal.name: index-not-json
illegal.title: index truncated mid-write — not parseable JSON
illegal.mutate: overwrite <name>.eprj3 with a half-written object

illegal.name: index-format-not-folder
illegal.title: index.format switched from "folder" to "zip"
illegal.mutate: json_set format = "zip"

illegal.name: index-owner-uuid-short
illegal.title: owner/creator/modifier uuid is not 32 hex characters
illegal.mutate: json_set owner_uuid = a 12-char string

illegal.name: index-timestamp-not-string
illegal.title: created_at turned into a number instead of a date string
illegal.mutate: json_set created_at = 1792832835531

illegal.name: index-second-project-file
illegal.title: a stray second .eprj3 index in the project root
illegal.mutate: copy the index to backup.eprj3

illegal.name: ecfg-fifth-record
illegal.title: Schematic1.ecfg carries a 5th record (legal shapes are 2 = V4 or 4 = V3)
illegal.mutate: raw_append one RULE line to the .ecfg

illegal.name: sheet-unparseable-line
illegal.title: a record line whose head JSON is broken
illegal.mutate: append a line whose head is truncated JSON

illegal.name: sheet-missing-separator
illegal.title: a line with no '||' head/body separator at all
illegal.mutate: append a bare token line

illegal.name: sheet-double-separator
illegal.title: a stray '||' inside the body: the rejoined body is not valid JSON
illegal.mutate: append an ATTR whose body is split by a second '||'

validate: record body is not valid JSON

illegal.name: ticket-duplicate
illegal.title: the same ticket number used twice inside one document
illegal.mutate: duplicate the first Designator attr line at end of the sheet main doc

illegal.name: ticket-regression
illegal.title: tickets go backwards at the tail of the PCB main doc (unique, but out of order)
illegal.mutate: swap the ticket numbers of the last two records
illegal.suggest: by design: record tickets are per-atom clocks, NOT a file-order invariant — the official quick-start project (client 4.1.78) has 813 backwards tickets in one sheet main doc; nothing may reject this

illegal.name: dochead-client-mismatch
illegal.title: an embedded SYMBOL doc keeps a foreign DOCHEAD client id
illegal.mutate: set the second SYMBOL doc's DOCHEAD body.client to a wrong id

illegal.name: symbol-attr-missing-doc
illegal.title: the A4 frame's Symbol attr points at a SYMBOL doc that is not embedded
illegal.mutate: set the first Symbol attr value to an unembedded uuid

validate: Symbol attr references missing SYMBOL doc

illegal.name: doc-uuid-duplicate
illegal.title: two docs in one container share the same uuid
illegal.mutate: copy the A4 SYMBOL doc uuid onto the second DEVICE doc

validate: Device attr references missing DEVICE doc

illegal.name: attr-parent-dangling
illegal.title: an ATTR whose parentId names no object in the document
illegal.mutate: reparent the first Unique ID attr onto a missing component id

illegal.name: component-head-id-missing
illegal.title: a COMPONENT head without an id — nothing can link attrs to it
illegal.mutate: drop head.id from the R1 component record

illegal.name: padnet-id-malformed
illegal.title: PAD_NET head id is not a JSON array
illegal.mutate: set the first PAD_NET head.id to a comma string

illegal.name: padnet-orphan-component
illegal.title: PAD_NET references a COMPONENT id that is not on the board
illegal.mutate: rewrite the component slot of the first PAD_NET id

illegal.name: padnet-net-without-net-record
illegal.title: PAD_NET carries a net the NET table never declares
illegal.mutate: set the first PAD_NET padNet to an undeclared net name

illegal.name: pour-flat-path
illegal.title: POUR path loses its nesting (a flat ring instead of an array of rings)
illegal.mutate: inject a well-formed witness pour (the skill builds none), then replace its nested path with a flat one

validate: path must be an array of polygon arrays

illegal.name: pour-undeclared-net
illegal.title: POUR named against a net the PCB never declared
illegal.mutate: inject a witness pour on GND (the skill builds none), then set its netName to an undeclared net

illegal.name: pcb-board-outline-missing
illegal.title: the BOARD_OUTLINE poly deleted from the PCB document
illegal.mutate: remove the BOARD_OUTLINE POLY record

illegal.name: pcb-empty-net-missing
illegal.title: the mandatory empty NET record deleted
illegal.mutate: remove every NET record whose id is ["NET",""]

illegal.name: pcb-layer-records-missing
illegal.title: the LAYER preamble deleted — the board declares no stackup
illegal.mutate: remove every LAYER record from the PCB main doc

illegal.name: pcb-footprint-attr-missing-doc
illegal.title: the PCB Footprint attr points at a FOOTPRINT doc that is not embedded
illegal.mutate: set the first PCB Footprint attr value to an unembedded uuid

validate: Footprint attr references missing FOOTPRINT doc

illegal.name: stray-file-in-schematic-dir
illegal.title: an unexplained extra file inside sch/Schematic1
illegal.mutate: write NOTES.txt next to the sheet documents

illegal.name: sheet-document-deleted
illegal.title: the sheet document P1.esch2 deleted while the index still lists it
illegal.mutate: remove sch/Schematic1/P1.esch2

illegal.name: sheet-file-truncated-empty
illegal.title: P1.esch2 present but empty (crash after a half-finished write)
illegal.mutate: overwrite the sheet document with zero bytes

validate: document file has no DOCHEAD records
